title: Creative catalogue: eighteen style applications
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.material: Clean paths with optional original paper texture
records.why: The frontier and waiting queue stay visible together, so search order can be checked.
records.check: Verify every visited node, legal edge and queue operation.
records.story_title: The Maze With a Waiting Line

records.material: Paper silhouettes or original textured objects
records.why: Footprints and retrieval paths are legible without perspective distortion.
records.check: Verify dimensions, occupied area and the specific retrieval rule.

records.material: Crisp lines and restrained chalk labels
records.why: Intervals can be counted without visual depth confusing the starting point.
records.check: Check signed arithmetic and keep the same unit spacing.

records.material: Ink on an original textured stage
records.why: The changing distance to the ribbon and the character’s strategy stay readable.
records.check: Check foot contact, ribbon continuity and the earned resolution.

records.material: Original cut-paper raincoat and background textures
records.why: Gentle parallax and a visible background gesture support the emotional reveal.
records.check: Inspect cutout halos, disocclusion gaps, grounding and clue visibility.

records.why: The nested planes make shelter and belonging tangible without requiring a full 3D model.
records.check: Do not call it true 3D; inspect camera limits and texture rights.

records.geometry: True 3D or explicitly labeled 2D isometric drawing
records.why: Parallel stations and the narrow gate can be inspected at the same time.
records.check: Distinguish projection from geometry and verify rates and queue counts.

records.material: Original block materials with soft practical light
records.why: Visible polygon facets and a coordinated wave make scale and sequence readable.
records.check: Check geometry, consistent lights, nonflashing timing and the propagation rule.

records.why: The character’s size, occlusion and route create embodied spatial stakes.
records.check: Establish scale, inspect contacts and keep the fictional crossing coherent.

records.material: Original paper fibers and restrained glow
records.layout: One shared lantern through several hands
records.why: Material and handoff staging emphasize cooperation while keeping the token identifiable.
records.check: Review every texture, hand contact, glow boundary and light-sensitive cue.

records.layout: Close action then resolved wide frame
records.why: Stitches and soft material make the act of care tangible.
records.check: Texture is not cloth simulation. Check seams, deformation and asset rights.

records.why: Weight, hesitation and small deformations communicate intention.
records.check: Preserve volume, contact and intentional timing.

records.why: Progressive drawing separates the disturbance from the motion of individual elements.
records.check: Check the actual model and ensure texture does not change element positions.

records.why: Multiple angles expose a mesh that a single flattering view could hide.
records.check: Check tooth engagement, ratios, shared time and native/source reopening.

records.geometry: True 3D or four independently authored consistent 2D views
records.why: This is multi-faceted as multiple perspectives, distinct from polygonal faceting.
records.check: Verify the puzzle answer and phone-size visibility in every panel.

records.why: The viewer can connect the outside motion to the hidden joining mechanism.
records.check: Match the inset to the same state and verify mechanism claims.
records.story_title: The Zipper Slider Makes Two Paths Meet

records.geometry: Exact vector plan and matching 3D blocks
records.why: The plan supports counting while the spatial view supports intuition.
records.check: Verify identical perimeters, areas, units and source geometry.

records.view: Two matched character views and a final wide view
records.why: Different viewpoints withhold different information until the whole is visible.
records.check: Keep artwork original, identities consistent and the final reveal earned.
records.story_title: The Painting Nobody Can See Whole
